assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis codes are I25.10, I34.0, and R42.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service CPT 93229 was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
Reason Code CO-197 indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.

The denial is reversed because the clinical indication note documents that Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
This service is covered under the plan guidelines for this diagnostic procedure.
